name: Khujechi Toke Raat Berate
overview: People say love is red, but no one says it's sometimes blood red. This love story is tainted and painted with blood. Sohini, the daughter of a famous painter lives in her palatial house with the valuable paintings of her father owned now by herself. She is married to Aditya, a stock marketeer. They had a happy married life until Aditya started losing his game and got stuck in huge loans. Aditya got more involved in his work as he was desperate to win back his career and doing so, he unknowingly got distanced in the marriage.
